# .github/workflows/pr-security-screen.yml). Version-pinned so scans are
# reproducible; Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) proposes bumps.

# Unlike the checksum-verified binary scanners (gitleaks, shellcheck), this pip
# layer is version-pinned, not digest-pinned -- an honest limit of installing
# from an index. Bandit is advisory; the authoritative gate is
# tools/security-screen.py.
